scene: The wind-up frog leaps across the workbench, knocking open a transit bay hatch.
picture: Flat side view across the open workshop. On the far left sits a streamlined bento express train. Left of centre, the grandfather holds his potted-plant bicycle beside the jumped frog. In the centre, the back hatch is thrown wide open, showing a mossy garden tram. Far right, an open gate reveals a yellow retro streetcar.
shown: a sleek bullet-nosed bento railcar waiting along the platform on the far left
a moss-draped garden tram hovering just outside the newly opened hatch in the centre
a clanging yellow retro streetcar stopped outside the side gate on the far right
